stage-1.itemsIn: 274 proposals and repairs (183 community proposals, 91 editorial repairs) plus 8 Introduction repairs
stage-1.findings: One analysis per proposal, in 100 batches
stage-1.decisions: Every item decided by two members
notes: Every open proposal at the 9 November freeze got an analysis and a two-member decision.
Editorial repairs (duplicated passages, split sentences, wrong section numbers) were filed alongside as Metaweb Academy proposals.

stage-2.findings: 48: 13 conflict, 11 cross-reference, 10 landing, 8 term, 3 scope, 3 duplicate
notes: Worked by issue: Broken text, Pointers and titles, Meaning (voted one by one), Steering decisions.
31 of the 34 findings with fixes touched one document.
Opened alongside Stage 1, so accepted changes flowed in as they were accepted.

stage-3.findings: 124: 56 typography, 20 terms, 15 references, 13 headings, 13 lists, 7 grammar
notes: "Meta-Layer" versus "meta-layer" is one book-wide decision; chapter-level fixes that pulled in both directions were dropped.
Decisions cover book-wide conventions (citation form, quote marks, heading case, section separators, tagline dashes) and patterns too frequent to fix one by one.
Beyond style: in DP4 Section 6 a deletion accepted in Stage 1 never landed, so the introduction appears twice. Filed as a decision.
One fix (an invisible no-break space in DP11) could not be filed.
Closed 13 Nov: both members accepted all 219 fixes; the 294 carried changes were kept. Decisions were recorded, but text changes they call for were not drafted in this stage.

final.analysis: 8 rounds: run-005 final read (8 analysts, 4 verifiers), re-checks run-006 to run-010 (2 to 5 analysts each), steward checks of single changes
final.findings: Round 1: 77, including 54 Stage 2/3 decisions recorded but never drafted, 14 new problems and 11 new choices. Later rounds: 7.
final.fixes: 906 applied: 583 in round 1, 302 carrying out round 1 choices, 21 from re-checks
final.decisions: 11, settled with one vote (Stage 4 rule); 28 documents signed off
notes: Round 1 found that Stage 3 had recorded steering's 48 decisions without drafting the edits they called for; 542 such edits were applied at once, with no second vote.
One vote carries a fix or settles a choice in Stage 4; each document's sign-off still needs two members.
Two sets of Stage 3 choices contradicted each other (citation form, quote marks); steering re-decided them: 'Section N' everywhere, straight quotes except the Introduction.
Re-checks read only the documents that changed, until every document came back clean (round 6, 20 of 20).
Acknowledgements Contributors regenerated: 69 entries, real names, both Calls for Input.

Seven documents (DP1, DP8, DP12, DP14, DP23, DP24, Cover) closed on one sign-off under an exception Daveed Benjamin recorded: Phahsa Ras approved them, but the sign-offs did not register because the list re-sorted while signing (fixed).
